mira chan: Hey — we need a clear partner response routing matrix for cloud marketplace + SI integrations. Yesterday's cross-org incident showed gaps.

sam patel: +1. current problems: unclear channel ownership, partner oncall contact not in bridge, and duplicate routing rules.

claire wong: Can we standardize by SEV level and have fallback to Redwood Dedicated oncall? Also define which partners get a dedicated bridge vs shared.

mira chan: Proposed sketch below. Keep it minimal.

``` 
SEV | Primary owner       | Partner contact       | Slack channel                          | Escalation target
SEV1 | Redwood oncall      | Partner SRE on-call   | #partnerships-<partner>-sev OR private bridge | 15m
SEV2 | Partner L2 lead     | Redwood SE            | #partnerships (with partner tag)       | 60m
SEV3 | Partner support ops | Redwood PM            | email + #partnerships                   | next business day
```

sarah-lo: I'll convert this into a one-pager and a minimal runbook template. Assigning @ops-oncall to review.

deploy-bot: Incident bridge created: https://redwood.inc/bridge/BR-2026-0315-17 (auto)

ops-oncall: I'll review the runbook tonight and confirm the PD escalation rules with infra.

claire wong: Suggest we add a 'data access check' step before inviting partner reps to private bridge for regulated customers.

sam patel: Good call. I'm going to ping marketplace leads and HW partners to collect preferred oncall contacts.

mira chan: Plan: Sarah drafts runbook by Wed EOD, Ops-oncall will validate, then we publish to partners doc and create per-partner channel templates. Meeting Friday 10:00 to finalize. :thumbsup:
